subject.title: refactor(memory-wiki): move compiled cache to plugin state

question: Should `registerMemoryPromptPreparation` become a supported public plugin SDK lifecycle contract, or should this asynchronous cache preparation remain an internal Memory Wiki/core seam until broader plugin use cases are approved?
rationale: The PR changes the public plugin contract and prompt lifecycle for all plugins, while the supplied context contains no explicit maintainer decision defining its compatibility and long-term ownership.

options.title: Require explicit SDK sponsorship
options.body: Pause merge until an owner confirms the public lifecycle contract, its intended plugin scope, and the compatibility expectations for synchronous prompt builders.

options.title: Keep the seam internal
options.body: Refactor the preparation hook behind an internal Memory Wiki/core integration until a broader public plugin API is designed and approved.

recommendation.title: Require explicit SDK sponsorship
recommendation.body: Pause merge until an owner confirms the public lifecycle contract, its intended plugin scope, and the compatibility expectations for synchronous prompt builders.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR’s commit history and stated architecture place this contributor closest to the proposed lifecycle contract and its intended scope.
